description: This file defines the Language model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve language data from a database, including individual languages by ID or code, and the list of all active languages.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Model class for managing language data, extending the base system engine Model class, includes methods for fetching language details from the database.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a language record by its ID, returning an array with language details, including constructing the image path based on language data.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a language record by its code, returning detailed information including image path.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves all active language records from the database, with caching, and constructs the image path for each language.
